signature: SUBROUTINE ZLATPS( UPLO, TRANS, DIAG, NORMIN, N, AP, X, SCALE,

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies whether the matrix A is upper or lower triangular.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the operation applied to A.

-   `= 'N'`: Solve $A \, x = s \, b$     (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: Solve $A^T \, x = s \, b$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: Solve $A^H \, x = s \, b$  (Conjugate transpose)

params.name: diag
params.reference:
Specifies whether or not the matrix A is unit triangular.

-   `= 'N'`: Non-unit triangular
-   `= 'U'`: Unit triangular

params.name: normin
params.reference:
Specifies whether `CNORM` has been set or not.

-   `= 'Y'`: `CNORM` contains the column norms on entry
-   `= 'N'`: `CNORM` is not set on entry.  On exit, the norms will be computed and stored in `CNORM`.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The upper or lower triangular matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

params.name: x
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side b of the triangular system. On exit, X is overwritten by the solution vector x.

params.name: scale
params.reference:
The scaling factor s for the triangular system

$$
A \, x = s \, b, A^T \, x = s \, b, \quad\text{or}\quad A^H \, x = s \, b
$$

If `SCALE = 0`, the matrix A is singular or badly scaled, and the vector x is an exact or approximate solution to $A \, x = 0$.

params.name: CNORM
params.reference:
If `NORMIN = 'Y'`, `CNORM` is an input argument and `CNORM(j)` contains the norm of the off-diagonal part of the j-th column of A. If `TRANS = 'N'`, `CNORM(j)` must be greater than or equal to the infinity-norm, and if `TRANS = 'T'` or 'C', `CNORM(j)` must be greater than or equal to the 1-norm.

If `NORMIN = 'N'`, `CNORM` is an output argument and `CNORM(j)` returns the 1-norm of the offdiagonal part of the j-th column of A.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -k`, the k-th argument had an illegal value
